disk_reclamation_rule: Only exact duplicates, disposable temporary artifacts, reproducible caches, and superseded noncanonical intermediates may be considered; canonical retained evidence must not be deleted merely to make room.
ranking_factors: expected marginal claim value per byte
recovery_form: bounded targeted tranche, not a blind attempt to download all held sources
recovery_timing: after non-OCR extraction, field/span extraction, deterministic/local classification, ingestion/codification, reconciliation/linkage, normalization/matching, whole-corpus integration, and claim-gap reassessment
